issues.evidence: In the contact sheet thumbnail (bottom right), the subtitle '本月只决定下一轮试点的排班范围。' ends with '。', and the paragraph mark appears cut off at the right edge of the text frame; the full-slide render shows it intact.
issues.suggestedChange: Widen text-0's frame (w 565 → ~600) or reduce wrap so the sentence and its punctuation fit inside the frame at thumbnail scale.

issues.evidence: Value labels (48, 26, 11, 7) sit immediately at each bar end with no consistent gap; the 48 label nearly touches the plot right boundary at x≈822, while the 7 label sits ~4px from its bar.
issues.suggestedChange: Add a fixed 6–8px offset between each bar end and its value label so labels align consistently.

issues.evidence: All four bars use the identical color 244F96, so the lead category (阅览室, 48) is not visually distinguished despite the title claiming it dominates.
issues.suggestedChange: Emphasize the lead bar with a darker/accent fill and mute the remaining three.

issues.evidence: The body text frames for week 1-3 are 298.22px tall but contain only a single short line of text, leaving large empty areas (visible as vast whitespace in the lower half of the slide).
issues.suggestedChange: Reduce the height of text-0, text-1, and text-2 to fit their content, or add supporting visual elements (icons, bullet points) to fill the space.
